functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide 100% of the required information about application requirements and services for all supported application types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive research capabilities, necessitating complete information availability for applicants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load requirement information and service options within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick access to information is essential for applicants researching requirements and selecting services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must organize requirement information and service options in a logical hierarchy with no more than 3 levels of navigation depth to reach any specific information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR focuses on research and selection, which requires intuitive information organization for effective user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide search functionality that returns relevant requirement information within 1 second and with at least 90% relevance for keyword searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Research capabilities require effective search functionality to help applicants find specific requirements quickly.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain 99.5% uptime during business hours (8AM-8PM local time) to ensure consistent access to application requirements and services.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Applicants need reliable access to research requirements and initiate applications online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement role-based access control ensuring that prospective applicants can only access public information and their own application data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user-initiated processes that require appropriate access controls to protect information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow administrators to update requirement information and available services within 1 business day of regulatory or policy changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR depends on up-to-date requirement information, necessitating easy maintenance capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new application types and services without requiring more than 5 person-days of development effort per new service.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system needs to adapt to new types of applications and services as organizational needs evolve.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support all required report formats (PDF, HTML, DOCX) with 100% format fidelity for publication and distribution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires report development for publication, necessitating support for standard document formats.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must generate and render reports of up to 100 pages with embedded graphics within 5 seconds for 90% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Staff need efficient report generation capabilities to complete their work without unnecessary delays.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The report editor must provide a WYSIWYG interface with formatting controls that match 95% of the functionality available in standard word processors.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Staff members need intuitive editing capabilities to effectively develop reports for publication.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must automatically save report drafts every 2 minutes and maintain recoverable versions for at least 7 days.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Report development requires protection against data loss to ensure staff productivity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement document-level access controls allowing report authors to specify which staff roles can view, edit, or publish specific reports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Reports may contain sensitive information requiring appropriate access controls.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the creation and modification of report templates that can be reused across departments with no more than 1 hour of configuration time per template.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Reusable templates improve efficiency and consistency in report development.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support import and export of report content from/to common office applications (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace) with 99% content and formatting preservation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Staff may need to work with external tools during report development, requiring seamless data exchange.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow for the configuration of custom distribution channels for reports (email, intranet, public website) without requiring code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Distribution needs may vary by report type and audience, requiring flexible publication options.
